component.name: Retroscrappy
component.summary: Scrape metadata and artwork for EmulationStation

description.p: Retroscrappy fills the gamelist.xml files of EmulationStation, as used by Batocera, RetroBat and Retrobox, with descriptions, box art, logos, screenshots and videos from ScreenScraper, SteamGridDB and IGDB.
Every field can also be edited by hand, and each item can be fetched individually from the source you choose.
